newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat up sharply in fast trade on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat up sharply in fast trade on fund buying.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures rallied strongly in fast trading on fund buying, with talk that Egypt was seeking U.S. wheat also cited, traders said.
Traders said Griffin Trading was buying the September as of 1105 CDT, which followed earlier purchases by E.D. and F. Man International and FIMAT Futures.
"Egypt is supposed to be in this weekend for a big chunk," a trader said.
Traders noted talk that Egypt was in the market for 750,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for September/October shipment.
E.D. and F. Man International bought 3.5 million bushels of September and FIMAT Futures bought 1.5 million September, traders said.
The market was technically oversold and due for a rally, and some traders expected that rainfall in the U.S. Midwest would slow wheat harvesting.
At 1110 CDT, CBOT soft red winter wheat futures were 6-1/4 to 13-1/4 cents per bushel higher, with July up 12 at $3.28-1/2. September was up 12-3/4 at $3.37-1/2.
